title: Home Mortgage Loans: Underwriting Limits and Eligible Occupancy by Program
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: Underwriting Limits and Eligible Occupancy by Program

Every program within Home Mortgage Loans publishes its own credit box: a floor and a ceiling on the amount lent, a ceiling on loan-to-value, a minimum representative credit score, a ceiling on debt-to-income, and the ways the borrower may occupy the property. This page lists those limits program by program.

## Terms used on this page

- **Smallest and largest loan amount** — the lower and upper bounds, in US dollars, on the amount a program will lend.
- **Maximum loan-to-value** — the greatest loan amount allowed, expressed as a percentage of whichever is lower: the appraised value or the purchase price.
- **Minimum credit score** — the lowest representative credit score that underwriting will accept.
- **Maximum debt-to-income** — the highest ratio of debt to income, in percent, that underwriting will accept.
- **Eligible occupancy** — the occupancy types a program admits, drawn from primary residence, second home and investment property.

## Limits by program

| Program | Smallest amount (USD) | Largest amount (USD) | Max LTV (%) | Min score | Max DTI (%) | Eligible occupancy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 50000.00 | 524225.00 | 96.5 | 580 | 57 | primary residence only |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 50000.00 | 1500000.00 | 100 | 580 | 60 | primary residence only |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 50000.00 | 832750.00 | 97 | 620 | 50 | primary residence, second home, investment |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 50000.00 | 832750.00 | 97 | 620 | 50 | primary residence, second home, investment |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 100000.00 | 1500000.00 | 95 | 660 | 45 | primary residence, second home |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 832751.00 | 3000000.00 | 80 | 700 | 43 | primary residence, second home |

## Program-specific qualification notes

- Each program qualifies a loan against its own LTV ceiling, score floor, DTI ceiling and occupancy list shown above.
- The VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage additionally requires that the borrower hold a VA certificate of eligibility.
- The Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage additionally requires that the amount lent be no less than its smallest amount of $832751.00, one dollar above the conventional ceiling of $832750.00.

## Points of judgement

**Can an investment property be financed under the FHA, VA, adjustable-rate or jumbo programs?** No. Investment occupancy appears only in the two conventional programs.

**Which program admits the highest loan-to-value?** The VA program, at 100 percent of the lower of appraised value and price.

**Hypothetical comparison.** Consider an imagined applicant with a representative score of 640 asking for $300000.00 on a primary residence. Against the published limits alone, 640 sits at or above the floors of the FHA, VA and both conventional programs, below the 660 floor of the adjustable-rate program and below the 700 floor of the jumbo program; the jumbo program is also out of range because $300000.00 is under its smallest amount. The figures in this comparison are invented for illustration, and whether any loan is approved remains an underwriting decision.
